extract_instance_id_from_mask_filename: extract the instance id from a BOP scenewise mask filename like 000345_000001.png
load_object_masks_for_image: load modal or amodal object masks for a given image id as a numpy array
read_scene_directory_infos: read a BOP scenewise scene directory and return which annotations like rgb depth and mask are available
load_scene_level_annotations: load scene_camera scene_gt and scene_gt_info JSON files from a BOP scenewise scene directory
load_all_image_data: load all data for a single image including rgb depth camera gt masks and gt_info from a scene
